instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open/use that file. A rectangular solid already exists, and its top outer contour is 40 x 20. Create a new sketch on the top face of the box. Externally project the complete top-face outer contour, then draw a circle of radius 4 at the projected contour center. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
